title: [NL] Fix CBG applies-to ID length handling
summary: In the NL CBG Statement Line, New Applies-to ID now returns Code[50] and payment tolerance handling stores the ID as Code[50], matching the existing field length. Longer valid applies-to IDs no longer fail during generation, increment or payment tolerance processing.
key_points: New Applies-to ID return type and the PmtTolCBGJnl local variable changed from Code[20] to Code[50]
First bank ID can keep the full 20-character statement document number plus its numeric suffix
Existing increment, suffix, cash-journal selection and payment tolerance logic are unchanged
Five tests added covering 10, 20, 21 and 50 character IDs, numeric carry, persistence and payment tolerance
Existing 10,000-line counter test updated to use a Code[50] variable
